notes.title: Several Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/1443ffa6a6c0b0cfaf044fa413e378b0c32072e3.png[/img]
We've uploaded update v. 1.16.3.14 with various bug fixes across stages, heroes, towers, enemies, navigation, and UI to improve overall gameplay stability and experience.

[b]Read the full changelog:[/b]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]


[h2]Level and Stage Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes taunt positions in stages 32, 37, 41
[*] fixes tower ember lords terrain hover
[*] prevents fog pseudo-towers from being hovered/focused
[*] fixes stage 41 secondary paths 2,3,4 missing
[*] fixes stage 41 gold steal parrot position
[*] fixes stage 16 and 19 taunt balloon position
[*] fixes stage 11 freeze hover image missing
[*] fixes stage 11 left cave mask width
[*] shows loading background 1 when opening tutorial
[*] fixes texture detail in stage 37
[*] fixes disappearing holder banners
[*] fixes desktop stage art glitches stages 6 and 10
[*] fixes stage 41 masks offset and zorder with holders[/list]

[h2]Hero and Tower Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes Snow Golem removal recovering nearest tower in stages 20-22
[*] fixes Arcane Magus using teleport when possessed by Lucerna
[*] Lucerna is no longer affected by Master Architects
[*] Sandworm and Ignis Altar are now affected by Master Architects
[*] fixes Beresad ult display
[*] fixes oloch ultimate moving when casted in path 3
[*] fixes Blazing Gem's Unstable Power upgrade scaling
[*] fixes Oloch buffing Sarcophagus
[*] fixes Ignis Altar not being affected by damage multipliers
[*] fixes Goblirangs Angry Bee not attacking flying enemies
[*] fixes Burning Fuel's damage
[*] fixes Wicked Sisters targeting Carnival Dragons with Froggification
[*] fixes HeroTank crash when spawning soldiers near path start
[*] fixes tower worm damage in encyclopedia
[*] fixes Winter Queen tower block not focusable
[*] some desert eagle fixes[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2][list]
[*] fixes Stonebeard Geomancer and Bullshark Dasher size modifier
[*] fixes Risen Cutthroats summoned by the fog from dead allied units giving gold
[*] fixes units summoning on unopened level 41 paths[/list]

[h2]Navigation and Focus[/h2]
[list]
[*] customizes tower nav overrides
[*] fixes crash in FocusNav
[*] fixes dismissing map rooms help with controller
[*] fixes tower room equipped towers navigation
[*] prevents equipping a locked tower in tower room
[*] fixes focus when popping hero/tower room help
[*] fixes hero/tower room help tooltip positions
[*] refactors wave flag tooltips positioning using anchor points
[*] fixes navigation overrides in upgrades room
[*] changes widget navigation distance calculation to use dyn nav algorithm
[*] nav override in hero room done/reset buttons
[*] disables mouse listener that reverts pointer
[*] focus nav override for briefing difficulty button
[*] fixes navigation in options down from slider
[*] fixes undoing tower selection after a build/upgrade of another ends
[*] re-enables navigation after end cutscenes
[*] fixes unreachable top item in quickmenu for level 4 towers
[*] fixes tower rally snapping outside range
[*] fixes quickmenu not showing tooltip on second opening[/list]

[h2]Encyclopedia and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] removes borders from comic 15 images (pirates dlc)
[*] fixes enemies health in encyclopedia with current difficulty
[*] fixes instakill missing in encyclopedia for Polyx and Hanged Captain
[*] fixes missing shadows in encyclopedia, green dots in some towers
[*] now shows instakill in infobar instead of None
[*] adds missing instakill damage to deep king info[/list]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes tower sell sounds not working when using keys/controller
[*] increases worm_nest_buy_skill sound
[*] adds limit_instances to bucaneer range attack sounds[/list]

[h2]General and Stability[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes several issues in data files
[*] fixes windows plist malformed in notifications/tips
[*] fixes page background glitches
[*] adds proxies for scramInfobar and others in KRGameplayScene
[*] fix stun id modifiers
[*] recovers from broken save game with empty tips key in notifications[/list]

[h2]Controller and Input Handling[/h2]
[list]
[*] controller: fixes “Press any button” not reacting to most buttons
[*] controller: restores pointer behaviour when selecting hero with keys
[*] controller: changes how pointer behaves when selecting hero with shoulder buttons[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] implements dynamic navigation mode for stages where towers are removed during the fight and overrides cannot be used (stages 20-22)
[*] improves encyclopedia navigation, changes page change sound
[*] improve navigation by making dyn nav distance wider
[*] improves navigation in tower and hero rooms
[*] avoids jumping to the other side when there is nothing to focus towards the selected direction
[*] improves mouse pointer tracking speed with joystick
[*] heavy refactor of pointer handling when switching between mouse/joystick/keyboard
[*] enables map flags panning with focus change
[*] hammerage melee attack can no longer be silenced
[*] Spectro now bleeds in violet instead of red
[/list]

notes.title: Arachnophobia Mini Campaign is Near!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34004563/f5d93ee386dc2a0c0854487d258154d85eae6322.png[/img]

General, our scouts bring urgent news!

We’ve found a tangled trail leading to remains of those accursed cultists. They refuse to accept defeat and, instead, seem to have found someone else to worship—an eight-legged, web-spinning abomination that calls herself the Spider Queen. A name that’s all too familiar…

Anyway, cultists and spiders? This can’t end well. 
It’s time to call the Alliance and put an end to all this web-spinning for good!

notes.title: The Clossal Dwarfare Campaign is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/297ada01d3d630724743345bb199541c6242d3f4.png[/img]
Grymbeard, the spiteful dwarf, is raising an army of clones and building a colossal war automaton in his own image!  Driven by vengeance and an ego as massive as his creation, he’s determined to bring the Kingdom to its knees. Overcompensating, much? 

There’s no time to ponder—The Alliance must journey to the Darksteel Mountains, where the metal giant nears completion, and put a stop to his nefarious plot!

[h3]Colossal Dwarfare Contents:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5 Treacherous New Stages through the Darksteel Mountains
[*] 12 Deadly New Enemies: from clones to sinister mechanical creations
[*] 2 Dreadful Minibosses and 3 Epic Boss Fights – waiting to be disassembled!
[*] 1 New Linirean Tower – the Cannoneer Squad makes an explosive debut
[*] 1 New Dark Army Hero – Kratoa, the Molten Rage, awakens from his slumber
[*] New Achievements for ultimate bragging rights
[*] Easter eggs packed with robotic surprises!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/91123f9fcd3925291c20c5a913629ed1d4f730a8.gif[/img]

Now’s your chance to lead the Alliance against the Colossal Dwarfare!
Time to take down Grymbeard! And Grymbeard! And… Grymbeard?

[h3]Get the NEW Colossal Dwarfare now!

We must rally the Alliance immediately. Take along Sylvara, the nature dragon and protector of the Arboreans, and don’t forget the new Bog Hermit tower. This giant toad mage has a unique ability—spitting mucus balls that can slow even the fiercest enemies.

Stay vigilant, General. The Croks have plenty of tricks up their scales!

notes.content:
Centuries ago, the Ancient Arboreans fought valiantly to contain him, sealing him in an eternal slumber. They understood the peril he posed. We cannot let the Kingdom face destruction!

notes.title: The Pirate Kings Exclusive Campaign is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/1817bd877a1c5926af7dde453cda0d64de086ed2.jpg[/img]
General, the time has come to show those so-called "Pirate Kings" who truly rules these waters!
My formidable Dark Army stands ready, awaiting your command to strike and reclaim my rightful lands.

To aid your conquest, I have put at your disposal a new tower, the Ogre Shipwreck, manned by my most merciless warmongers. And the ghostly Captain Lucerna of the Haunted Galleon shall join you, her specter powers ready to make those knaves Walk the Plank!

Be swift and vigilant, General, for those cowards will be expecting our arrival. I intercepted their pathetic attempts to "warn each other" of our army - as if that would make a lick of difference to my plans! 

[b]Now, make those swindlers face my Vengeance, once and for all![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/9b8428590a515fd55017838819e7fae69d52134c.gif[/img]

[*] [b]NEW ENEMIES:[/b] Make corsairs, buccaneers, parrots, cheeky monkeys, and more walk the plank!
[*] [b]BOSS FIGHTS:[/b] Prepare your cannonballs for the 5 “Pirate Kings”, including one familiar face.
[*] [b]NEW HERO:[/b] Meet Lucerna, the Ghost Ship captain with ghostly powers and bombastic firepower!

[*] [b]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS:[/b] What’s a pirate adventure without its tasty treasures?

[/list]

notes.title: Tower tune-up update 🔧
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/81ec9f34a12655635af00478f8fca952d9a5ae2c.png[/img]

[b]Version 1.15.6 is here, where the weaker towers got a pep talk and bugs got the boot.  [/b]

For those balance nerds out there, here is a list of all changes for your satisfaction.

[h2][b]Balance changes:[/b]
[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Shadow Archers:[/b]
Level  3 cost: 190 -> 180
Level  4 cost: 280-> 260
Level 2 max dmg: 11 -> 12
Level 3 max dmg: 21-> 22
Level 4 min dmg: 23 -> 24 // max dmg: 34 -> 36
Shadow Mark CD: 20 -> 18

[*] [b]Orc Warriors Den:[/b]
Level 1 respawn: 12 -> 10
Level 2 respawn: 12 -> 10
Level 3 respawn: 12 -> 10
Level 4 respawn: 12 -> 10
Level 4 basic min dmg: 9 -> 11 // max dmg: 14 -> 16
Captain Orc basic min dmg 14 -> 16 // max dmg: 21 -> 23

[*] [b]Infernal Mages:[/b]
Basic dmg: 5-16/16-49/33-100/49-146 -> 8-15/24-44/48-86/78-134
Infernal Portal CD: 25sec -> 22 sec // Teleport: 15 nodes -> 20 nodes
Affliction cost 150/150 -> 120/120 // -25/50% armor resist -> -30/60% armor resist
Lava Fissure dmg: 28-42/56-84/80-120 -> 32-56/66-98/100-130

[*][b] Rocket Riders:[/b]
Level 2 cost: 210 -> 200
Level 3 cost: 310 -> 280
Level 4 cost: 370 -> 320
Level 3 range 370 -> 380
Level 4 range 390 -> 400
Minefield CD: 10sec -> 8 secs // Area: 50 -> 75
Nitro Boosters CD: 15sec -> 12 sec
Defective Engines cost: 250/250 -> 150/150  // CD: 22sec -> 20 sec

[*] [b]Dark Knights:[/b]
Level 2 hp: 130 -> 140
Level 3 hp: 180 -> 200
Level 4 hp: 240 -> 260
Level 4 respawn: 10 -> 8

[*] [b]Melting Furnace:[/b]
Basic dmg: 5-7/14-18/25-31/41-50 -> 6-8/16-20/28-34/44-52
Red Hot Coals cost: 140/180 -> 140/140 Area: 40 -> 75

[*] [b]Spectral Mausoleum:[/b]
Spectral Communion cost: 300/150 -> 150/100
 
[*] [b]Goblirangs:[/b]
Return Dmg: 50% -> 100%
Biggarang: 30-55/35-65/45-90 dmg -> 52-78/63-91/88-105

[*] [b]Elite Harassers:[/b]

notes.title: Balance Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/a998ffb5848c1c079c7e2a047259db8d4e1383f7.jpg[/img]

Hey, Rushers! While working on the Hammerhold Campaign, we thought, "Why not make things even more awesome?" So, we've smoothed out some pesky bugs and tweaked the balance, all thanks to your suggestions. You don't need to purchase the DLC to see the upgrades.

Curious? Check out the changes below.

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crow damage 1/2 -> 2/4
[*] Demon Guard melee 4-8 -> 6-10
[*] Demon Guard lifetime 12s -> 18s
[*] Demon Guard death explosion damage 10/40 -> 20/50
[*] Orc Shaman damage 4-20/10-55/20-110/35-190 -> 4-20/12-55/25-110/40-190
[*] Static Shock damage 3-13/6-26/10-38 -> 5-20/10-35/15-50
[*] Rocket Riders damage 7-10/20-29/40-58/64-92 -> 8-12/23-33/46-68/74-104
[*] Minefield cost 300/300/300 -> 225/225/225
[*] Biggarang damage 27-49/32-60/43-81 -> 30-55/35-65/45-90
[*] Abrasive Heat range 400 -> 530
[*] Blazing Gem level 1 damage 2-4/4-8/6-12 -> 2-4/4-7/6-10
[*] Blazing Gem level 2 damage 6-9/12-18/18-27 -> 6-9/11-17/16-25
[*] Blazing Gem level 3 damage 10-16/20-32/30-48 -> 10-15/20-30/30-45
[*] Blazing Gem level 4 damage 16-24/32-48/48-72/64-96 -> 14-22/30-44/44-65/58-88
[*] Grim Cemetery level 4 default spawner cooldown 15s -> 12s (matches other levels)
[*] Bloated Corpses cooldown 12s -> 3s
[*] More monks cost 350/350/350 -> 175/175/175
[*] Ignis Altar damage type physical -> explosive
[*] Ignis Altar puddles now stack
[/list]
Find the full Changelog complete with bug fixes  [url=https://github.com/cigumo/krvi/wiki/Changelog#v11540--18-12-2023-steam---testing]here[/url].

notes.title: The Hammerhold Campaign DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/658fea414d298df08be9e42a05b4f44498ceb8f5.jpg[/img]

Did my ears deceive me? King Malik?[b] KING MALIK[/b]? [b]The audacity! [/b]Have they all taken leave of their senses, forgetting the true sovereign that reigns supreme in this Kingdom?

Did they ACTUALLY believe Hammerhold could stand a chance against my Dark Army? Until now, I merely dismissed them, occupied with more important matters. But no longer.

Now, General, seize the hour! Lead a surprise assault on the desert’s shores, catching them off guard. Let’s wake them up from their delusions and get this little rebellion done and over with.

[b]Let our dark dominance be absolute! 
[i]Take my Vengeance to Hammerhold once and for all!![/i][/b]


[h3]What's in the Hammerhold DLC:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]5 new stages:[/b] A whole new campaign packed with action and powerful enemies. 
[*] [b]3 minibosses and 1 boss: [/b]Familiar faces are back… and they’re not thrilled to see you!
[*] [b]New hero: [/b] Behold Isfet, a formidable mummy warlock with an arsenal of curses. 
[*] [b]New tower:[/b] The Sandworm Hollows' appetites are (mostly) at your disposal.
[*] [b]New achievements: [/b]And savor the sweet taste of bragging rights that come with them!
[*] [b]Easter eggs galore: [/b]The desert may hold secrets, but it also has a sense of humor.
[/list]

[b]Get it now:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695220/Kingdom_Rush_Vengeance__Hammerhold_Campaign/

notes.title: What's included in the Hammerhold DLC?
notes.content:
So, you've received an invitation from Vez'nan to pay a not-so-friendly visit to Hammerhold, and now you're probably thinking, "What in the world am I getting into?". [b]Before you reach for that sunscreen, learn all about what secrets are hiding in the desert dunes.[/b]

[h2] HAMMERHOLD DLC INCLUDES:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/5608446744d47cf41d64c05466e99cd2546d5006.png[/img]

[h3]NEW THRILLING STAGES AND BOSSES
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]5 new stages: [/b]A whole new campaign packed with sand-tastic surprises. Disembark on the desert's shores. Replenish at Sape Oasis. Explore ancient pyramids. Seize Hammerhold once and for all!

[*] [b]10+ new enemies: [/b]The Legionnaires have recruited an eclectic and rather quirky force.  Prepare to face assassins, war elephants, djinnis. And even... magic carpets? 

[*] [b]3 minibosses and 1 boss: [/b]Remember those heroes you thought were gone for good? They're back, and they're not here for a cozy family gathering. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/8ee180bfa7114ec74a9bc868f7fcee228f15b655.gif[/img]

[h3]THE DESERT'S FIERCEST JOIN YOUR RANKS!
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New hero:[/b]  Behold Isfet, a formidable mummy warlock, wielding an arsenal of spells and curses. Just don't make any "wrapped up" jokes – he’s not in the mood for puns.

[*] [b]New tower:[/b] The Sandworm Hollows have appetites as insatiable as a kid in a candy store. They'll gulp down anything in their path, be it friend or foe. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/e6aec79964f500aefb6a2623282a5f544f57a8f0.gif[/img]

[h3]AND OF COURSE…
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The lore thickens: [/b]You wanted to know about Hammerhold and their heroes, right?

[*] [b]New achievements: [/b]And savor the sweet taste of bragging rights that come with them!

[*] [b]Easter eggs galore: [/b]The desert may hold secrets, but it also has a sense of humor.
[/list]
[i]
[b]So, have you made up your mind, General?[/b][/i]
[i][b]Don’t keep the Dark Lord waiting too long, he’s known to get impatient! [/b][/i]

[h3]Add it to your wishlist![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695220/Kingdom_Rush_Vengeance__Hammerhold_Campaign

notes.title: The Primal Ravage update is here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/7d2120a0fb52093c577888d23b61102b4ed82e3b.png[/img]

General!

The day has arrived and our new update,  Primal Ravage, is now available!
Go now and take command of my troops and show them those unworthy dwarves and dinosaurs who the rightful ruler of this land is!

I am pretty sure they will get petrified once they see you charge, and those dwarves will not be a BIG problem, for sure!

In this new adventure you will have to face 3 new stages with a thrilling boss fight. You can count on the aid of a new tower and a new hero I’m leaving at your disposal!

Get ready as there are new enemies on the rise but you can also unlock 4 new achievements!

I am done with the talking, go now and fulfill my revenge!

notes.title: New Kingdom Rush Vengance update: Primal Ravage coming September 29!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/068ae643eec44a6c74dd735778ae40bc3ad2d48f.jpg[/img]

My loyal Generals!! 

[b]A NEW UPDATE is coming to Vengeance on September 29,[/b] and you need to prepare for it!
Some pesky and ancient-looking little dwarves are emerging from the ancient mines. 

Normally that would not be a problem for our troops, but they are bringing with them some disgusting lizard-like creatures that have very pointy claws and teeth, and they are keen on using them!

Since I am busy with other issues I am sending a new hero, Grosh, and a new tower, the Ignus Altar, on my behalf. You better not disappoint me or you will feel my rage!

While you are at it, punish those pesky dwarves that opened the mine passage and allied with their ancient counterparts. Apparently, there is no shortage of dwarves in these lands!

[i][b]Get your sword, shield, and spells ready! I am counting on you... or else…!
[/b][/i]
